name: 26b_dspark
description: 26B Gemma4-A4B MoE-target DSpark config: FP8 target (identical env/sampling/concurrency to 26b_e011_mtp baseline) + DENSE DSpark draft (design A). Apples-to-apples vs 26b_e011_mtp and 26b_eagle3 except draft+method+spec_tokens. Target = google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-text-only (MoE); draft at /tmp/models/dspark/26b_finetune. spec_method=dspark uses vLLM --speculative-config (method=dspark). Native block size = 7, so spec_tokens=7 (vs 5 for MTP/eagle3). gpu_memory_utilization 0.8 for the 262144-vocab draft headroom. Override target/draft via GEMMA4_MODEL_PATH / GEMMA4_SPECULATOR_MODEL. Use 26b_dspark_bf16 first to smoke-test, then this for the headline FP8 number.
